This is a webviews where we can manage a mannequin with different clothes and change each part of the mannequin (top, bottom, shoes, accessories) by selecting items from different categories. The code includes components for selecting categories and displaying the mannequin with the selected clothes.

## Coding Guidelines
- Use a consistent project structure for components, hooks, services, types, utilities, and styling.
- type everything with TypeScript. do not use any.
- Use React functional components and hooks.

- Optimize images, use Tailwind CSS, and maintain code quality with ESLint and Prettier.
